name: Palace and Park of Versailles
description: Southwest of Paris, Versailles was home to the French kings and their court from 1682 until the Revolution in 1789. Louis XIV built it to glorify the monarchy, and its vast palace holds about 2,300 rooms. Outside, 93 hectares of formal gardens lead to canals, the Trianon retreats and Marie Antoinette's make-believe village.
